submission.natural_language_explanation: This is a recency-mixing head: its write is a weighted average of the head-values of the last ~5 tokens (mean attention 0.15 self, 0.21 previous, 0.17 two back, 0.12 three back, 0.08 four back, decaying to ~0.01 by lag 10) and, in a text's first four tokens only, of the opening token with 0.4-0.6 of the weight, so it leaves its mean write when that window holds a token with an atypical head-value: the same word is far more active after a bracket or a name than after 'the'. It is strongly active (0.6-1.0 of max, 3.3-5.5) at tokens 2-4 of any text whose first token is a bracket or a bracket-led token ('(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}', '（', '「', '『', '【', '“', '{{', '{%', '([', '[1]', '(a)', '[Update]', '(Note)'), inactive (0.10-0.20 of max, 0.57-1.16) for a text that opens with 'The' plus a common lowercase word and runs on as plain prose with no bracket, quote, digit or proper name, borderline (about half of all texts cross the line there) for any other opener, and past the first ~6 tokens it only grazes its line (0.2-0.35 of max) at a capitalised or rare token such as a surname after a given name.

rival_explanations: Position-only artifact: the head carries no token content at all, crossing its line at tokens 2-4 of roughly half of all texts whatever the opener (mere decaying tail of the position-0 attention sink) and never above the line past token 6, so bracket and non-bracket openers differ only in how often their value happens to be atypical.

General rarity detector: the head fires wherever a rare, capitalised or symbol token sits in its last ~5 tokens, mid-text as strongly as at a text's start, so 'The committee discussed photosynthesis for an hour' should be as active as '[Footnote 63' and a text opening with 'Xenophanes' or 'NASA' should be as active as one opening with '('.

Word-piece continuation detector: the head is really tracking multi-token words, firing at the second piece of any tokenizer-split word ('J'+'ug', 'H'+'arp', 'Commun'+'ications') wherever it appears, and the bracket openers only look special because the word after a bracket is usually a no-space continuation piece.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Bracket opener followed only by common lowercase words: the hypothesis predicts a strong peak at tokens 2-3 from the opening bracket alone, while a rarity account predicts nothing here and no word in the probe is split into pieces.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The engineer explained how to document the failure mode before the design review begins.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The hypothesis's named inactive class ('The' plus a common lowercase word, plain prose, no bracket, quote, digit or proper name) carrying the trigger word 'document' in its verb sense.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: [1] The operator is defined as the limit of this sequence as n grows.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Opens with the listed bracket-led token '[1]' followed by ordinary math prose; the hypothesis predicts tokens 2-4 above the line on the strength of the opening token, and nothing in it is split into continuation pieces.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The artist painted the harbour every morning before the shops opened on the square.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the claimed trigger 'artist' at token 2 but after a plain 'The' opener, and every word is a single token, so the hypothesis predicts no peak because the opening token is typical while the rarity and word-piece accounts have no rare or split piece to fire on.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: {% if ready %} the page will show the latest news for your region {% endif %}
adversarial_test_results.detail: Opens with the listed template bracket '{%'; the hypothesis predicts a strong early-window peak from the opening symbol, in a genre close to the github-code examples.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The report from the committee notes the decline in shipping over the last decade.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Pure plain-prose control in the hypothesis's inactive class with no trigger and no split or rare token, calibrating the baseline that all three rivals also call inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: (Hazelwood later denied that he had left the bridge before the grounding)
adversarial_test_results.detail: Bracket opener with the example's proper name in the first window; the hypothesis predicts strong activation, and 'Hazelwood' splits into 'H'|'az'|'el'|'wood' so the word-piece rival predicts a peak at tokens 2-4 too, leaving this to separate the position-only rival.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The editor added a footnote about the missing pages at the end of the chapter.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Lowercase 'footnote' at token 5, past the early window, in plain prose; the hypothesis allows at most a graze there, while the rarity rival expects a peak on the word that tops the pg19 examples (' footnote' is a single unsplit token, so the word-piece reading has nothing to fire on).

adversarial_test_results.prompt: 「今日の会議は中止になりました」と部長が言った。
adversarial_test_results.detail: Japanese holdout whose literal first token is the listed corner bracket '「'; tests the bracket claim in a language and script that no example covers.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The lesson began with a long discussion of photosynthesis and its role in the cycle.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A rare technical word whose pieces ' photos'|'ynthesis' start at token 9, past the early window, inside a plain 'The' sentence; the hypothesis permits only a graze, while the rarity and word-piece rivals predict a full peak.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: (La reunión se trasladó a la sala pequeña del segundo piso)
adversarial_test_results.detail: Spanish holdout whose literal first token is a plain parenthesis; the hypothesis claims bracket openers work whatever the language, while the many split Spanish words ('reun'|'ión', 'pe'|'que'|'ña') also give the word-piece rival a reason to fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The board met again to revise its communications policy after the long review.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A policy word from the same family as the examples' 'ications' continuation sits at token 8 in a plain 'The' sentence as a single unsplit token; the hypothesis predicts no peak, the rarity rival a graze-to-peak on a rare word.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: “The committee agreed to postpone the final vote until the spring.”
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same words as an ordinary committee sentence but opening with a curly quote: if the opening token drives the early-window peak this fires, while the rarity account sees only common words, and the split ' post'|'pone' at token 6 gives the word-piece rival its own reason to fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The crew stored the heavy iron harpoon below deck and waited for the ice to clear.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The WordNet 'whole' word 'harpoon' starts at token 7 (as ' har'|'poon') with no bracket and no name; the hypothesis says past token 6 such a word only grazes the line, while the rarity and word-piece rivals predict a peak.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: (Note) the figures below include shipping and handling charges from the supplier.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Opens with the listed bracket-led token '(Note)' followed by common English prose, so only the opening-token claim predicts a peak.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The forum post ended with a note from the moderator: [Update] the thread is now locked.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A listed bracket-led token arrives only at token 12 (' ['|'Update'|']'), away from the opening window; the hypothesis says a bracket there cannot produce a strong peak, while the rarity rival predicts one.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: [Footnote 63: the appendix gives the full table of results.]
adversarial_test_results.detail: Reproduces the pg19 footnote shape with a different continuation; the hypothesis predicts tokens 2-4 active from the opening bracket, even though 'Footnote' is a single unsplit token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The utility company repaired the lines after the storm and restored power by noon.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The trigger's word-family appears at token 2 as a single lowercase token in an ordinary 'The' sentence, exactly the hypothesis's inactive class, with no split or rare piece for the other rivals to catch.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: (a) the tenant shall keep the garden in reasonable condition throughout the term.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Legal-register genre holdout whose literal first token is the listed '(a)' marker, testing that a bracket opener works outside the scan genres and with unremarkable following words.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The manual explains the procedure in detail. [Footnote 63: see below for the full table.]
adversarial_test_results.detail: The same bracket and trigger token as the pg19 examples but the ' [' only arrives at token 9 and 'Footnote' is a single unsplit token at token 10; the hypothesis says a bracket past the first ~6 tokens only grazes the line.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Xenophanes argued that the one is all and that change is an illusion.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A rare capitalised proper-name opener split as 'X'|'en'|'oph'|'anes': the hypothesis classes every non-bracket opener as borderline (about half cross), whereas the rarity and word-piece rivals both claim a strong peak at tokens 2-4.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The appendix to the second chapter lists formulas 100 and 101 for the reaction rates.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The claimed digit tokens arrive at tokens 9 and 11 of running prose with no opening bracket; the hypothesis predicts a graze, the rarity rival a full peak.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: NASA announced a new program to study the upper atmosphere this year.
adversarial_test_results.detail: An all-caps rare opener split as 'NA'|'SA', so the second piece sits at token 2; the hypothesis classes this as borderline rather than bracket-strength, while the rarity and word-piece rivals both claim bracket-level activation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The lecture covered the life of Joseph Hazelwood and the events that led to the accident.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The example's given-name-then-surname pattern moved to tokens 7-10 (' Joseph'|' Haz'|'el'|'wood') in a plain 'The' sentence, where the hypothesis says such a name only grazes the line.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Photosynthesis converts light into chemical energy in the leaves of plants.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A rare opener that splits as 'Photos'|'ynthesis', putting a continuation piece at token 2; the hypothesis makes only bracket openers strong, so this is borderline at best, while the rarity and word-piece rivals predict a peak.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The reviewer observed that the phrase “a short account” appeared twice in the draft.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A curly-quote bracket at token 7 with no other trigger and no split word; the hypothesis restricts the strong quote effect to a text's first token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The museum will document the restoration of the painting in a new catalogue.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Second sense of the trigger 'document' (verb, a single token) after a 'The' opener with no bracket, digit, name or split word; the hypothesis predicts the inactive band.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The document lay on the table until the assistant filed it with the rest.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The trigger 'document' as a plain noun at token 2 in ordinary prose, a single token with no split pieces; a word-piece account has nothing to fire on and the hypothesis says the typical 'The' opener keeps it inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The artist's studio smelled of turpentine and old canvas throughout the summer.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The claimed 'artist' trigger at token 2 after 'The' is one token, but 'turpentine' splits as ' tur'|'pent'|'ine' at tokens 7-9, so the word-piece rival predicts a mid-text peak and the hypothesis does not.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: El documento incluye una nota al pie sobre el artista y su obra completa.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Spanish same-topic negative after a non-'The' opener, which the hypothesis leaves borderline, while several words split into continuation pieces (' document'|'o', ' art'|'ista') so the word-piece rival predicts a peak; the rarity rival should stay quiet on common Spanish words.
